stateful_dataset_exemption.reason: Durable operational state for this EKS upgrade lab is the offline Terraform plan graph, Kubernetes manifests, step checkpoints under /app/var/upgrade, and deterministic upgrade-report digests rather than a business SQL seed corpus. Estate telemetry and interruption histories are deterministic JSON inventories consumed by the local upgrade lab; a 10k-row relational payments database would not exercise add-on trust, IRSA, PDB drain, or regulated placement semantics.

domain_state_model: compatibility-ordered EKS add-on and controller version plans
IRSA assume-role subjects and scoped IAM policy actions
PodDisruptionBudget coverage during system node drain
regulated workload nodeSelectors and Karpenter on-demand fencing
step checkpoints with atomic restart recovery
canonical READY/FAILED upgrade reports with SHA-256 digests
production_authenticity.reachability_evidence: All graded state is planned through /app/terraform, applied via /app/k8s manifests, and exercised by /app/bin/addon-trust-rollout against the local upgrade_lab without live AWS or cluster calls.
